newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea Dainong Group says to generate 820 bln won.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea Dainong Group says to generate 820 bln won.

text.p: South Korea's financially troubled Dainong Group said on Wednesday it would raise 820 billion won by the end of the first half of 1998 by selling affiliates and real estate.
A Dainong group statement said it would curtail the number of group affiliates to four from 21 at present.

The nation's leading textile and retail business group plans to focus on the remaining four units, including Dainong Corp and Midopa Department Store, which were slated for bail-out by a voluntary committe of financial institutions.
Creditors agreed on Wednesday to grant 5.7 billion won in rescue loans to Dainong Corp and 10.2 billion won to Midopa.
Earlier, a SEOULBANK official said the two companies had requested 78 billion won in total. But a Dainong statement later said they had requested 86.2 billion won.
As part of its self-rescue plan, Dainong said it would induce capital investment at home and abroad, and switch short-term loans to longer-term, the statement said.
Dainong's debt totalled 1.7 trillion won on 1.5 trillion group turnover last year.
The group spent 128.8 billion won to ward off a hostile takeover bid by Shindongbang Corp early this year. Dainong has said that defence led to its troubles.
